'At the beginning of your end phase, put a -1{d} counter on this.' / '**Blade Break**' - Generic Equipment - Chest (DuskTillDawn).

BLADE BREAK NOT AUTHORED: printed keyword (printed_keywords, DB keywords ['BladeBreak']) with a live branch in build_keyword_triggers (triggers/triggers.py:244-249, event combat_chain_close, condition _defended_this_chain). Re-authoring it would be a defect.

UPKEEP TRIGGER: BEGINNING_OF_END_PHASE is dispatched to BOTH players' permanent/equipment zones at EITHER hero's end phase (engine.py:1495-1503; chest is among the zones), so release note 1 ('only ... your end phase, not your opponent's') is carried by IS_ACTIVE_PLAYER value:true (condition_types.py:811-821 reads 'value'; controller == active_player). Its absence is the documented channel_iceloch_glaze_blue review finding (fires twice per round).

PUT_COUNTER (effect_types.py:2015-2058) reads counter_type/amount/target and defaults to the SOURCE card when no target is given (:2031) = 'on this'. counter_type '-1d' is in DEFENSE_COUNTER_KINDS (ability_keywords.py:211), so it routes through _apply_defense_counter (:226-253) instead of being inert bookkeeping - that function writes the card-level tally under the normalised kind 'minus_defense' and reduces {d} on every recalc. Counters accumulate across turns as printed.

RELEASE NOTE 2 ('if this has 3 or more -1{d} counters, its defense value is 0, and does not become negative'): printed {d} is 2 (card_data/slug_index.json 'defense': 2), so plain per-counter reduction reaches 0 at two counters and would go NEGATIVE from the third onward - _apply_defense_counter's immediate update (ability_keywords.py:252-253) and the recalc reset (engine.py:2053) both compute base - counters with no floor. The second ability clamps exactly that case: a WHILE_STATIC naming trigger RECALC_DEFENSE runs only on the defence recalculation (interpreter.py:186-202 wanted-event check); IS_DEFENDING_CARD scopes it to the defender currently being evaluated (combat.defense_recalc_card, condition_types.py:564-604) - without it the dispatch reaches this equipment once per EVERY defender and would zero other cards; COUNTER_GTE reads counter_type/min (condition_types.py:998-1030) against the card tally that _apply_defense_counter wrote as 'minus_defense'. MODIFY_DEFENSE mod:'set' amount 0 targets combat.defense_recalc_card during recalc and floors at max(0, delta) (effect_types.py:2678-2714) = 'is 0, does not become negative'. With fewer than 3 counters the static's conditions fail and reduction stays exact (2-n >= 0 for n <= 2), so the clamp only ever bites where the note says it should.

Set-folder note: eventual home json/dtd/ per the DuskTillDawn set identifier.
